cscience-compass.reason: Mentions alignment with a magnetic field, but explains it as being stuck in a stable middle of the field.

cscience-mirage.reason: Attributes the apparent water to an actual suspended layer of water; does not explain refraction.

cscience-thunder.reason: Restates the order without explaining the different propagation speeds.

cscience-whale.reason: Claims evolution from a single cell distinguishes whales from fish; omits mammalian traits and ancestry.

ctest-dot.reason: Correct indexed sum of pairwise products for equal-length lists, including the empty case.

ctest-unique.reason: Only emits a function call, with no implementation.

ctest-streak.reason: Counts only the initial positive run instead of the longest run anywhere.

ctest-overlap.reason: Compares one character with the full pattern, so multi-character occurrences are missed.
